title: Overlay lock files are left untracked after kbs comment and close
description: Reported by the Biblicus session on 0.37.0: after kbs comment, kbs close and kbs commit in a fresh worktree, project/.overlay/locks/<issue id>.lock remains as an untracked file, so gh pr create warns about uncommitted changes. project/.overlay/ is a local cache and must never appear in git status. Fix one way: kbs init writes a gitignore rule for project/.overlay/ (and kbs doctor reports and offers the fix when the rule is missing), and lock files are removed when the operation that took them finishes. Spec both; both runtimes.
